text.text_excerpt: I really enjoyed my stay at Green House Inn. I love old houses, so it was a treat for me to stay here. It's location on Magazine St. allowed me to walk to shopping and a few restaurants and bars. I felt like I lived in New Orleans all over again. The pool is beautiful! All of the tropical vegetation makes it feel like a tropical paradise! It's very relaxing. There's even a nice little library so you can grab a book and read by the pool. It's also close to the French Quarter, the CBD, St. Charles Ave., Uptown... anyplace you want to go in the intown area. This is just a really cool place and the owners are very nice and make sure you have everything you need. This is a great place to stay ...

There are so many reasons you should stay here the next time you are in NOLA. The location (lower Garden District) is perfectly situated between Uptown, the Warehouse District, the Quarter, and the "proper" Garden District. The neighborhood is delightful - I want to visit every bistro, bar, and coffee shop. The window shopping was amazing, especially if you are in the market for some cute clothes (vintage included). The Inn keepers are kind, professional gentlemen who really do seem to be living the life fantastic! They have cultivated so much: a charming ambiance, a clean Inn, a tranquil mood, and a gorgeous garden atmosphere. The tropical pool and hot tub area is literally right out of ...

I really can't even begin to describe how wonderful our visit was to the Green House Inn but I'll do my darndest to give it a go... First, the website is update and good representation/description of the rooms and grounds but it doesn't even begin to touch what the place is like in reality. From the off street parking to the friendly staff (Hi Frank!) to the nibble available at all hours to the saltwater pool (clothing optional) to the location, the Inn is everything you need to make your trip to New Orleans complete. No loud French Quarter shenanigans here! Folks from all over the world come here to relax, relax, relax. Our first room (yes, first room...we ended up staying an extra night...
